stimulus.question: Checkout is reported to show elevated errors in the OTel Demo. Using the authorized metrics range query and trace search for the last 5 minutes, determine whether checkout and its dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) show failures or elevated latency, cite trace ids, and return a json investigation report.

claims.text: In the final 5-minute window (12:33:26–12:38:26), checkout emitted ERROR-status spans on oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (increase ≈1.25) and on its outbound oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge span (≈1.25), while PlaceOrder also had ≈1.25 non-error (STATUS_CODE_UNSET) spans; payment's own grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge span showed ERROR ≈1.25, and cart POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart plus checkout's oteldemo.CheckoutService/prepareOrderItems and oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart ERROR series were 0.

The best-supported cause of checkout's elevated errors is payment's own Charge handler rejecting the charge as an invalid token (application error surfaced as gRPC UNKNOWN=2 from payment, converted by checkout to INTERNAL=13 and to HTTP 500 at frontend): error spans are localized to checkout's PlaceOrder/Charge client spans and payment's grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge span, and the failure text and stack trace point into payment's charge.js rather than to any downstream dependency.

Latency- or timeout-driven checkout failures are rejected: the failed PlaceOrder span completed in 43110 us and its payment Charge client span in 21513 us with an explicit application error message, i.e. it failed faster than the successful PlaceOrder in the same sample (81049 us) and its successful Charge span (8710 us), and no deadline-exceeded/unavailable status appears.

A failure in cart, product-catalog, currency, shipping or email as the cause of checkout's errors is rejected: in the failing trace those dependencies returned rpc.grpc.status_code=0 / HTTP 200 spans, cart's error series was 0 in the window, and no ERROR-status span series exists for product-catalog, currency, shipping or email in the past hour.

A payment-specific latency regression is not supported: payment's server Charge mean rose from 3.38 ms to 9.06 ms, but in the same final 5-minute window cart POST/EmptyCart (7.50→15.41 ms), cart POST (5.16→13.51 ms), shipping GetQuote (5.62→10.25 ms), email send_order_confirmation (11.19→21.02 ms) and product-catalog GetProduct (0.246→0.367 ms) also roughly doubled against a 40-minute pre-window, and each window contains only single-digit span counts (e.g. 2 PlaceOrder spans), so the shift is broad and within window-to-window noise rather than attributable to payment.

The intermittent ≈1.25 ERROR spans on ad, flagd and recommendation appear in every part of the past hour, including windows before checkout/payment errors began (windows ending 11:43:26–12:13:26), so they are pre-existing background rather than part of this checkout/payment failure pattern.
